summary: Relative Vigor Index: the close-minus-open move compared with the bar range over 10 bars, with a signal line.
overview: The Relative Vigor Index (RVGI) compares where bars close relative to where they open, in its own pane. In up moves, closes tend to be above opens; in down moves, below.
It shows an RVGI line in green and a signal line in red.
how: Numerator = (close - open) smoothed with weights 1, 2, 2, 1 over four bars. Denominator = (high - low) smoothed the same way. RVGI = sum of numerators / sum of denominators over 10 bars.
Signal = RVGI smoothed with the same 1, 2, 2, 1 weights.
use: Some traders watch RVGI crossing its signal line.
Use readings above zero as a sign closes are beating opens.
Pair it with a trend tool for context.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
It reacts quickly and can cross often in ranges.
